name: Lint

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'challenges/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/lint.yml'
      - '.pre-commit-config.yaml'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - '.flake8'
      - '.clang-format'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'challenges/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/lint.yml'
      - '.pre-commit-config.yaml'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - '.flake8'
      - '.clang-format'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint-python:
    name: Lint Python
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install black isort flake8

      - name: Check Python formatting with black
        run: |
          black --check --diff challenges/ scripts/

      - name: Check Python imports with isort
        run: |
          isort --check-only --diff challenges/ scripts/

      - name: Check Python linting with flake8
        run: |
          flake8 challenges/ scripts/ --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics
          flake8 challenges/ scripts/ --count --exit-zero --max-complexity=10 --max-line-length=120 --statistics

  lint-cpp:
    name: Lint C++/CUDA
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install clang-format
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y clang-format

      - name: Check C++/CUDA formatting
        run: |
          find . -type f \( -name "*.cpp" -o -name "*.h" -o -name "*.cu" -o -name "*.cuh" \) -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./build/*" -not -path "./venv/*" | xargs clang-format --dry-run --Werror

  lint-mojo:
    name: Lint Mojo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate Mojo files
        run: |
          # Basic validation for Mojo files
          # Check for common syntax issues and missing imports
          find . -type f -name "*.mojo" -not -path "./.git/*" | while read file; do
            # Check if file is empty
            if [ ! -s "$file" ]; then
              echo "Warning: Empty Mojo file found: $file"
            fi
            
            # Check for basic syntax patterns (simple grep checks)
            # Ensure files have some content
            if ! grep -q "fn\|struct\|class\|import\|from" "$file"; then
              echo "Warning: Mojo file may be missing standard definitions: $file"
            fi
          done
          
          # Exit with success if no critical errors
          echo "Mojo validation completed"

  pre-commit-check:
    name: Pre-commit Checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Run pre-commit
        uses: pre-commit/action@v3.0.1
        with:
          extra_args: --files $(find . -type f \( -name "*.py" -o -name "*.cpp" -o -name "*.h" -o -name "*.cu" -o -name "*.cuh" -o -name "*.mojo" -o -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" \) -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./build/*" -not -path "./venv/*" | tr '\n' ' ')
